phase: INS-002D Private River OS Callback / Contact Request Ingress
objective: Create the private River OS POST ingress for requesting immediate or callback contact without selecting or invoking a telephony provider. The ingress validates same-origin writes, canonical relationship identity, supported channel and intent, verifies that the relationship exists in River CRM, and fails closed until a provider runtime is explicitly composed in INS-002E.
security: The route reuses the canonical same-origin River CRM write guard.
No public quote route gains telephony controls.
No phone or email destination is accepted from the browser.
The browser submits only canonical relationship identity, channel, and intent.
Actual destination remains server-resolved by INS-002C.

providerGate.behavior: Fail closed with 503 after request and relationship validation until INS-002E composes an authorized provider adapter.

acceptanceCriteria: Form parsing is canonical and provider-neutral.
Relationship ID must use relationship: identity.
Unsupported channel or intent is rejected.
Missing River CRM binding fails closed.
A valid request cannot invoke a provider before INS-002E.
The route accepts no phone number or email destination field.
No provider SDK or network call is added.
